capabilities: Draw circles and rectangles over figures
List and delete annotations by page
extras: Desktop only (no mobile or tablet support); requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or newer and is verified only on Windows 11. Annotations are written into the original PDF as standard Highlight, Square and Circle annotations, which may affect digital signatures; encrypted or signed PDFs are not covered. No network requests, telemetry, accounts or paid services. Interface is in Simplified Chinese.
intentEvidence: adds Chinese-language annotation controls to Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer has no annotation tools and no way to connect a PDF passage to an existing note.
summary: Chinese-language PDF annotation toolbar for Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer that highlights text, draws shapes, adds comments, and links annotations to notes.
